recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not reintroduce Observation.valueReference or Observation.component.valueReference under FHIR-39112. If OO and Clinical Genomics want a new R6 mechanism such as Reference, CodeableReference, or an extension for MolecularDefinition/Medication-related use cases, handle it through a new or explicitly advanced current-cycle tracker; also align FHIR-53610's Jira workflow with the already-applied source change.
issue_request: FHIR-39112 asked OO to allow Reference as a value data type on Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x], citing genomics use cases for referencing a Medication in a component and a MolecularSequence as an observed value. Jira status is Published with resolution Persuasive and Applied for Version R5.
initial_application: OO accepted the issue on 2023-02-02 and Jira points to PR 2610 commit c09d2d2, but that specific commit only adjusted a component-value-canonical search parameter. The substantive overlapping source change was FHIR-40292 commit 398f7536c6715b0d74192b66d93351384e243cf8, which added Reference(MolecularSequence) and canonical to both Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] with related comments and search-parameter work. FHIR-40560 commit 3223f3da2f17c8a97a17e674159201cd37aa9d89 then removed canonical, restored string, and kept the restricted Reference(MolecularSequence) choice for both value elements before R5 publication.
additional_context: Current Observation remains in build scope via source/fhir.ini. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml omits Reference and canonical from both requested value elements, and source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml has no corresponding value-reference/value-canonical search parameters. FHIR-53610 and commit c5527236970a7f34d402a473125298cfc0a3dd31 removed the remaining valueReference choices and search parameters as orphaned after MolecularSequence/MolecularDefinition work moved out of core. A 2025 genomics Zulip thread shows the community was still debating the right R6 modeling approach rather than reaffirming FHIR-39112's broad Reference request.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding Reference for FHIR-39112 would conflict with later R5 narrowing/removal decisions and the current R6 source state.
